integrity: All displayed limiting statements are established by generator convergence and an explicit conditional-maxima argument; finite computations reproduce rates and exact identities. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
limitations: Fixed finite hub count; initial infection of one hub; unweighted continuous-time asynchronous push–pull; distributional, not mean, convergence. No implication for growing hub count or alternate update rules.
title: Two-scale Rayleigh-to-Gumbel spreading on \(K_{a,b}\) with finitely many hubs
